notes.title: Warbox System Requirements Update
notes.notes:
[h1]UPDATED SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS[/h1]
Warbox System Requirements have been updated. A lot of players that have been reporting performance issues may possibly be below these standards. Before this change, the minimum specs were as high as a GTX 1050 GPU. Make sure you verify that your PC is above minimum specs before buying the game. The minimum requirements were increased due to the new use of technology in Unreal Engine 5, Lumen Global Illumination, Nanite, and Metahumans.

[h1]UNREAL ENGINE 5[/h1]
Also read on the Unreal Engine 5 system requirements if your PC is below Warbox's minnimum requirements but you still want to see if you can run the engine.
https://docs.unrealengine.com/5.0/en-US/hardware-and-software-specifications-for-unreal-engine/

notes.title: Warbox Summer Update Devlog
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello All!
Tay here with a new update for the WB community.

This month has been very busy for Warbox, recently we made the decision to upgrade to Unreal Engine 5 which has allowed us to dive into a brand new tool set, rendering features and more. Over the last couple of weeks Mantaliss has been dedicated to improving, refactoring code and addressing many of the general issues surrounding faction customization, UX and more. These changes are wide sweeping and will allow our players to take even more advantage of the massive pool of content included and coming to Warbox.[/h3]

[h1]New Customization Menu[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032331/19130aae156d0f432991cc734c4e139b7c15a2dc.png[/img]

[h3]The new customization menu has been laid out to be a bit more efficient and navigable. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032331/fc09c83cfc283b89c7410b0ce1905f346df27654.png[/img]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/723435699818463274/980188786032013322/unknown.png?width=844&height=676[/img]

[h3]Bring to life your ultimate creative desires with full color masking and control on all cosmetics. [/h3]

[h1]New Lighting powered by Lumen[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032331/969daf18da312ce706b0a678fc7b507c1a1d99bd.png[/img]

[h3]With UE5 we are taking full advantage of the power of Lumen, this will increase visual fidelity, provide realistic shadows and light bouncing.[/h3]

[h1]New Gameplay Additions[/h1]

[previewyoutube=H1TYM1YtLT0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]AI Commanders[/h3]

[previewyoutube=RrNCv5QC0j4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Acog Functionality[/h3]

[h1]New Maps Built from the ground up[/h1]

[h2]Helmskeeper (Based on Rural Ukraine)[/h2]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/723435699818463274/980225074864996392/screen2.png?width=1202&height=676[/img]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/723435699818463274/980225074089054288/screen1.png?width=1202&height=676[/img]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/723435699818463274/980225077629046904/screen7.png?width=1202&height=676[/img]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/723435699818463274/980225075489964174/screen3.png?width=1202&height=676[/img]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/723435699818463274/980246361675034686/HighresScreenshot00018.png?width=902&height=676[/img]

This is just a tid-bit of all that we have been working on. In future updates we will be bringing even more maps, fixes, features and more. Some planned things we have in mind:
[list]
[*]Vietnam Era Content And Maps
[*]Future Era Content and Maps
[*]Integrated Modding Support
[*]Comprehensive Vehicle AI and Transportation (AI Driving, Dropping off, Insert)
[*]More Sandbox Features
[*]Cinematic Mode
[*]Zombies
[*]Animals
[*]Weapons and Animations
[*]Improved Gibbing, Gore and Blood
[*]More Soundtrack and In Game Music Selection
[/list]

With all of these new features, content and additions Warbox will be increasing to $15 USD price tag for the Unreal Engine 5 update so grab it for the current price while you can!
 
We hope that you thoroughly enjoy the new content we are bringing and look to take Warbox to brand new heights this Summer. For those of us in the United States please enjoy your memorial day weekend and remember the sacrifice the few have made for the many.

Thank you all for your support and continued enjoyment of Warbox.

See you guys on the Battlefield.
